title: Physics-informed deep learning guides a synthesized titanium halide electrolyte
summary: The authors synthesize Li₄TiBr₄Cl₄ and report room-temperature ionic conductivity of 1.14 mS/cm. A laboratory cell retained 90.6% capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C.
ai_technology: Physics-informed neural network; dual-source graph neural network

evidence.tested: The abstract reports synthesis, structural characterization, conductivity and cell cycling.
evidence.unknown: The comparison used indexed abstract evidence. Baselines, detailed protocol and independent replication remain to be checked.
evidence.ai_role: Two neural networks helped screen inorganic crystals and identify titanium halides for synthesis.
